$comment: Key-value access patterns for galactic-unicorn-remote's state. There is no relational store requirement in the memos: desired state, observed state and `gen` are a handful of scalars held by one process (memo §5.1, §7.3), and the audit log is 'a small append-only log' (memo §7.3). The single backing store is an OPEN DECISION (description.md §6.4) — in-memory-with-append-only-file vs SQLite. This file pins the ACCESS PATTERNS, which are store-independent.

gen.written_by: durable command edges only (start | cancel | replace-cancel | replace-start)
gen.invariant: never decreases within a process; on a fresh process it is re-seeded from the board's reported applied_gen + 1 so it can never sit below the board's high-water mark (memo §5.1)
gen.note: One counter that both sides agree on. No clock is involved on either side.

desired.ttl_note: '~45 s' is the design intent; the exact constant is an OPEN DECISION (description.md §6.4). Expiry is enforced server-side; the board never compares expires_at (memo §5.4).
desired.on_expiry: read as { action: 'none' } and dropped; never queued, never fired late (memo §4, §5.4)
desired.on_new_boot_id: cleared immediately, before the poll's desired state is computed (memo §5.6)
desired.invariant: exactly one writer (the phone) per direction; the board never writes this slot (memo §2)

observed.shape: { boot, fw, applied_gen, state, routine?, remaining_s?, rssi?, uptime_s?, received_at }
observed.invariant: exactly one writer (the board) per direction; the server never writes this slot (memo §2)

derived.online: received_at is within the offline threshold; threshold is an OPEN DECISION (description.md §6.4)

applied_gen.writer: the board (reported every poll, persisted to flash on the board)
applied_gen.note: Held here only as a mirror of the board's value; the authoritative copy is on the board's flash.

subscribers.invariant: a LIVE subscriber count, never 'a page was loaded' (memo §11.7)

replace_sequence.note: Server-side orchestration for cancel → wait for `state: ambient` reported → start. Lives on the server, NOT in the firmware, so no 'authority priority' field enters the toddler-facing state machine (memo §3, §5.5). Abandons if the panel goes away mid-sequence.

transitions.advance: on a poll reporting state=ambient AND applied_gen >= cancelled_gen, set desired start target_routine
transitions.abandon: panel offline past abandons_at, or a newer command supersedes this sequence

routines.source: routines.json — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for ids and labels; no hard-coded labels anywhere (memo §12)
routines.symbols_note: the panel's symbol artwork is the only identity channel on both surfaces (duck / book / toy-box)

next_poll_ms.invariant: server-generated and clamped; the board further clamps to its config.py floors/ceilings (memo §6.3.5)

must_survive_restart: nothing strictly (state is a mirror of the board's truth), but the audit log is expected to survive
must_never_exist_here: a server-computed countdown / remaining_s source of truth (memo §5.3)
a copy of the board's applied_gen as authority (the board's flash is authoritative)
